title: Flaky: graphty "lands a layout change on the bare canvas's fit, whenever the key card comes up"
body:
CI's results service detected this graphty test as flaky (it failed, then passed on the retry of the same inputs) in the last 7 days:

- File: `graphty/src/workspace/canvas/__tests__/FramingIgnoresOverlays.real-element.test.tsx`
- Test: `the drawing is framed in the canvas alone > lands a layout change on the bare canvas's fit, whenever the key card comes up`
- Shard: graphty (real-element project)

The test applies the Circle layout on Les Miserables four times (key card never shown, shown before the layout change, right after it while its fit is pending, and after the fit landed) and asserts every node lands within 1 px of the bare-canvas picture. An intermittent failure means the picture it reads is sometimes not the settled one.

Related: #3372 (canvas is the frame), closed.
